issues.description: The template's decision-diagram module defines the compute table as '_CT', but the simulator module imports and expects 'CT'. This identifier mismatch will cause an ImportError or NameError when students try to run or import the simulator, blocking them before they can implement the exercises.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the compute-table identifier consistent across repositories. For example, rename '_CT' to 'CT' in the template dd.py (or change the import in dd_simulation.py to import '_CT' instead). Prefer exporting 'CT' (no leading underscore) so simulator code and examples match the variable name used in the solution.
